title.zh: 维尼健康推出自主品牌清洁护理产品线：从床旁清洁到日常肌肤护理
title.en: VINNER Health Launches Its Own-Brand Personal Cleansing and Care Line: From Bedside Cleansing to Everyday Skin Care

body.zh: 对于住院患者、行动不便的老年人、长期照护人群以及新生儿而言，“清洁”是日常卫生的一部分，更直接关系到舒适度、肌肤状态以及护理人员的工作效率。基于二十余年的湿巾研发与制造经验，维尼健康（VINNER）推出个人清洁与护理产品线（Personal Care & Rinse-Free Cleansing Collection），针对传统洗浴、洗发或皮肤清洁不便的场景，提供更加便捷、温和的日常护理解决方案。
body.en: For hospitalized patients, older adults with limited mobility, people receiving long-term care, and newborns, “cleansing” is part of everyday hygiene—but it also directly affects comfort, skin condition, and caregiver efficiency. Drawing on more than two decades of wet-wipe R&D and manufacturing experience, VINNER Health has launched its Personal Care & Rinse-Free Cleansing Collection. Designed for situations where conventional bathing, hair washing, or skin cleansing is inconvenient, the collection provides a more convenient and gentle solution for everyday care.

news.alt: VINNERLOVE 与 HOMEKEEP 清洁护理产品线

heading.zh: 两大品牌，覆盖不同清洁护理需求
heading.en: Two Brands, Covering Diverse Cleansing and Care Needs

body.zh: 目前，该产品线主要包括 VINNERLOVE 和 HOMEKEEP 两个品牌，覆盖不同年龄、不同护理环境和不同清洁需求。
body.en: Today, the line mainly comprises VINNERLOVE and HOMEKEEP, covering different ages, care settings, and cleansing needs.

bullets.zh: 免冲洗身体清洁
bullets.en: Rinse-free body cleansing

bullets.zh: 免冲洗头发清洁
bullets.en: Rinse-free hair cleansing

bullets.zh: 失禁及潮湿暴露皮肤护理
bullets.en: Care for incontinent and moisture-exposed skin

bullets.zh: 婴幼儿与敏感肌清洁
bullets.en: Cleansing for infants and sensitive skin

paragraphsAfter.zh: 相关产品在欧盟、中东、美国等主要市场通常按照化妆品或个人护理产品路径进行市场准入。
paragraphsAfter.en: In major markets such as the European Union, the Middle East, and the United States, these products typically enter the market through the cosmetics or personal-care product pathway.

heading.zh: VINNERLOVE：面向成人及专业护理场景的清洁护理系列
heading.en: VINNERLOVE: A Cleansing and Care Range for Adults and Professional Care Settings

body.zh: VINNERLOVE 主要针对医院病房、养老院、长期护理机构以及居家护理中的成人清洁护理需求。
body.en: VINNERLOVE primarily addresses adult cleansing and care needs in hospital wards, nursing homes, long-term care facilities, and home-care settings.

paragraphs.zh: 对于卧床、术后、行动不便或需要他人协助完成个人卫生护理的人群，传统洗澡和洗头往往意味着需要准备清水、脸盆、毛巾，并频繁调整被护理者体位。
paragraphs.en: For people who are bedridden, recovering from surgery, have limited mobility, or need assistance with personal hygiene, a conventional bath or hair wash often requires clean water, a basin, towels, and frequent repositioning of the person receiving care.

paragraphs.zh: VINNERLOVE 因此围绕“免冲洗护理（Rinse-Free Care）”开发产品，让身体清洁、头发清洁以及失禁相关皮肤护理能够在床旁或其他护理环境中更加方便地完成。
paragraphs.en: VINNERLOVE therefore develops products around “Rinse-Free Care,” making body cleansing, hair cleansing, and continence-related skin care easier to complete at the bedside or in other care settings.

paragraphs.zh: 目前主要包括以下产品：
paragraphs.en: Its current range mainly includes the following products:

heading.zh: 1. VINNERLOVE Bed Bath Wipes｜免冲洗沐浴湿巾
heading.en: 1. VINNERLOVE Bed Bath Wipes — Rinse-Free Bathing Wipes

body.zh: 采用免冲洗清洁护理液的大尺寸湿巾，用于全身床旁清洁护理。每包 8 片，可按照不同身体部位进行分区清洁，无需另外准备清水、脸盆或毛巾。
body.en: Large-format wipes infused with a rinse-free cleansing and care solution for full-body bedside cleansing. Each pack contains 8 wipes, allowing different body areas to be cleansed separately without preparing additional water, a basin, or towels.

paragraphs.zh: 产品可在使用前适当加热，在进行床旁沐浴时提供更加温暖、舒适的护理体验。
paragraphs.en: The wipes may be warmed before use to provide a warmer, more comfortable bedside bathing experience.

paragraphs.zh: 特别适合：
paragraphs.en: Particularly suitable for:

bullets.zh: 住院卧床患者
bullets.en: Hospitalized bedridden patients

bullets.zh: ICU 及术后患者
bullets.en: ICU and postoperative patients

bullets.zh: 行动不便的老年人
bullets.en: Older adults with limited mobility

bullets.zh: 长期卧床或需要辅助沐浴的人群
bullets.en: People who are bedridden long-term or require assisted bathing

bullets.zh: 居家康复及家庭护理
bullets.en: Home rehabilitation and family caregiving

paragraphsAfter.zh: 手册将其典型使用场景概括为床旁沐浴、老人护理、长期照护、家庭护理以及旅行或应急清洁。
paragraphsAfter.en: The manual summarizes typical use cases as bedside bathing, elder care, long-term care, home care, and travel or emergency cleansing.

heading.zh: 2. VINNERLOVE Bed Bath Gloves｜免冲洗沐浴手套
heading.en: 2. VINNERLOVE Bed Bath Gloves — Rinse-Free Bathing Gloves

body.zh: 将免冲洗清洁护理液与手套式无纺布结合，使护理人员可以直接佩戴进行身体擦拭。
body.en: Combining a rinse-free cleansing and care solution with glove-shaped nonwoven fabric, the product allows caregivers to put on the gloves and wipe the body directly.

paragraphs.zh: 与普通湿巾相比，手套结构在协助他人进行背部、四肢、腋下等身体区域清洁时更加容易控制，也更适合床旁护理操作。
paragraphs.en: Compared with ordinary wipes, the glove format is easier to control when assisting with cleansing the back, limbs, underarms, and other body areas, and is better suited to bedside care.

paragraphs.zh: 产品同样采用 8 片式全身护理设计，可用于完整的身体分区清洁，并可在使用前适当加热。
paragraphs.en: It uses the same eight-piece full-body care design, supporting complete area-by-area body cleansing and allowing the gloves to be warmed before use.

heading.zh: 3. VINNERLOVE Rinse-Free Shampoo Cap｜免冲洗洗发浴帽
heading.en: 3. VINNERLOVE Rinse-Free Shampoo Cap

body.zh: 传统床旁洗头往往需要准备水、脸盆和毛巾，同时还需要调整患者体位并进行后续清理。
body.en: Traditional bedside hair washing often requires water, a basin, and towels, as well as repositioning the patient and cleaning up afterward.

paragraphs.zh: 免冲洗洗发浴帽将清洁护理液预先加入浴帽中。使用时将浴帽佩戴于头部，通过轻柔按摩使护理液充分接触头发和头皮，完成清洁后无需再用清水冲洗。
paragraphs.en: The Rinse-Free Shampoo Cap comes preloaded with cleansing and care solution. To use it, place the cap on the head and massage gently so the solution fully contacts the hair and scalp; after cleansing, no rinsing with clean water is required.

paragraphs.zh: 它特别适合传统洗头不方便的人群，有助于简化床旁洗发流程，减少取水、使用脸盆和毛巾以及后续清理等步骤。
paragraphs.en: It is especially suitable for people for whom conventional hair washing is inconvenient, helping simplify the bedside hair-washing process by reducing steps such as fetching water, using a basin and towels, and cleaning up afterward.

paragraphs.zh: 因此，在医院病房、养老院及居家护理中，它可以帮助护理人员更轻松地完成头发卫生护理，同时帮助被护理者保持清爽、舒适和体面。
paragraphs.en: In hospital wards, nursing homes, and home-care settings, it helps caregivers complete hair hygiene more easily while helping the person receiving care stay fresh, comfortable, and dignified.

heading.zh: 4. VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes｜4 合 1 乳霜护理湿巾
heading.en: 4. VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes — 4-in-1 Continence Care Wipes

body.zh: 对于长期卧床、失禁或行动不便的人群，皮肤可能长期接触尿液、粪便、汗液，并经历反复擦拭和清洁。
body.en: For people who are bedridden long-term, experience incontinence, or have limited mobility, skin may remain exposed to urine, feces, and sweat for extended periods and undergo repeated wiping and cleansing.

paragraphs.zh: VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾采用含乳霜的 4 合 1 护理设计，通过一次擦拭同时完成清洁、保湿、舒缓以及提供屏障防护。
paragraphs.en: VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes feature a cream-based 4-in-1 care design, completing cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection in a single wipe.

paragraphs.zh: 相比需要分别使用清洁产品、保湿产品、舒缓护理产品以及皮肤屏障产品的传统多步骤护理方式，一片湿巾即可完成多项日常皮肤护理步骤。
paragraphs.en: Compared with conventional multi-step care, which requires separate cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and skin-barrier products, a single wipe can complete multiple daily skin-care steps.

paragraphs.zh: 适用于医院、养老院、长期护理机构和居家护理环境，特别适合失禁人群、老年脆弱肌肤以及长期卧床或久坐人群的日常皮肤护理。
paragraphs.en: Suitable for hospitals, nursing homes, long-term care facilities, and home-care settings, they are especially suited to everyday skin care for people with incontinence, older adults with fragile skin, and those who are bedridden or seated for long periods.

heading.zh: HOMEKEEP：面向婴幼儿与敏感肌的温和日常清洁
heading.en: HOMEKEEP: Gentle Everyday Cleansing for Infants and Sensitive Skin

body.zh: 与 VINNERLOVE 更偏向成人及专业照护场景不同，HOMEKEEP 更关注婴幼儿及敏感肌肤的日常温和清洁。
body.en: Unlike VINNERLOVE, which focuses more on adult and professional care settings, HOMEKEEP focuses on gentle daily cleansing for infants and sensitive skin.

heading.zh: HOMEKEEP 纯水婴儿湿巾
heading.en: HOMEKEEP Pure Water Wipes

body.zh: HOMEKEEP 纯水婴儿湿巾专为新生儿及敏感肌设计，采用 100% 植物基纤维无纺布和纯水配方，不添加酒精、香精及对羟基苯甲酸酯（Parabens）。
body.en: HOMEKEEP Pure Water Wipes are designed for newborns and sensitive skin. They use 100% plant-based nonwoven fiber and a pure-water formula, with no alcohol, fragrance, or parabens added.

paragraphs.zh: 柔软且具有一定厚度的湿巾材料使其适用于：
paragraphs.en: The soft, suitably thick wipe material makes them suitable for:

bullets.zh: 新生儿日常清洁
bullets.en: Everyday cleansing for newborns

bullets.zh: 换尿布时的皮肤清洁
bullets.en: Skin cleansing during diaper changes

bullets.zh: 手部、面部及身体日常擦拭
bullets.en: Everyday wiping of hands, face, and body

bullets.zh: 敏感肌人群的温和清洁
bullets.en: Gentle cleansing for people with sensitive skin

bullets.zh: 居家及外出护理
bullets.en: Care at home and on the go

paragraphsAfter.zh: 通过 HOMEKEEP，维尼健康将清洁护理产品线从专业成人护理进一步延伸至婴幼儿和家庭日常护理。
paragraphsAfter.en: Through HOMEKEEP, VINNER Health extends its cleansing and care line beyond professional adult care to infants and everyday family care.

heading.zh: 从医院病房到家庭：一套产品覆盖多种护理场景
heading.en: From Hospital Wards to the Home: One Product Line for Multiple Care Settings

body.zh: 维尼健康清洁护理产品线并不是围绕单一使用环境设计，而是针对不同护理阶段中的实际清洁需求进行组合。
body.en: VINNER Health’s cleansing and care line is not designed around a single use environment; instead, it brings together products that address practical cleansing needs at different stages of care.

heading.zh: 1. 医院及住院病房
heading.en: 1. Hospitals and Inpatient Wards

body.zh: 对于卧床、术后、ICU 或行动受限患者，传统淋浴和洗头可能难以实施。
body.en: For bedridden, postoperative, ICU, or mobility-limited patients, conventional bathing and hair washing may be difficult to carry out.

paragraphs.zh: 在这种环境下，产品可以分别支持以下护理任务：
paragraphs.en: In this setting, the products can support the following care tasks:

bullets.zh: 免冲洗沐浴湿巾 / 沐浴手套 → 用于床旁全身清洁
bullets.en: Rinse-free bathing wipes / bathing gloves → For full-body bedside cleansing

bullets.zh: 免冲洗洗发浴帽 → 用于无法正常洗头患者的头发及头皮清洁
bullets.en: Rinse-free shampoo cap → For hair and scalp cleansing when a patient cannot wash their hair normally

bullets.zh: 失禁护理乳霜湿巾 → 用于失禁及潮湿暴露皮肤的日常清洁与护理
bullets.en: Continence care cream wipes → For everyday cleansing and care of skin exposed to incontinence and moisture

bullets.zh: 纯水婴儿湿巾 → 用于日常局部皮肤清洁
bullets.en: Pure Water Wipes → For everyday cleansing of specific areas of the skin

paragraphsAfter.zh: 这些产品共同组成一个更加完整的床旁个人卫生护理方案。
paragraphsAfter.en: Together, these products form a more complete bedside personal hygiene care solution.

heading.zh: 2. 养老院及长期护理机构
heading.en: 2. Nursing Homes and Long-Term Care Facilities

body.zh: 养老院中的很多住民可能存在行动不便、长期卧床、失禁或需要护理人员协助完成日常个人卫生的问题。
body.en: Many nursing-home residents may have limited mobility, be bedridden long-term, experience incontinence, or need caregivers to assist with everyday personal hygiene.

paragraphs.zh: 与传统洗浴相比，免冲洗产品可以让护理人员直接在床边或房间内完成部分日常清洁护理。
paragraphs.en: Compared with conventional bathing, rinse-free products allow caregivers to complete some routine cleansing and care directly at the bedside or in the resident’s room.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，一次完整的护理流程可以包括：身体清洁 → 头发清洁 → 失禁及脆弱皮肤护理，从而覆盖老年人日常个人卫生护理中的主要需求。
paragraphs.en: For example, a complete care routine could include body cleansing → hair cleansing → care for incontinent and fragile skin, covering the main personal hygiene needs of older adults.

heading.zh: 3. 居家护理
heading.en: 3. Home Care

body.zh: 随着居家康复和家庭照护需求增加，类似的问题也越来越多地出现在家庭环境中。
body.en: As demand for home rehabilitation and family caregiving grows, similar challenges are increasingly appearing in home environments.

paragraphs.zh: 对于术后康复、行动不便、长期卧床或由家人协助护理的人群，免冲洗产品能够减少对浴室、热水、脸盆和大量护理用品的依赖。
paragraphs.en: For people recovering after surgery, with limited mobility, bedridden long-term, or cared for by family members, rinse-free products can reduce reliance on bathrooms, hot water, basins, and a large number of care supplies.

paragraphs.zh: 护理人员可以根据需求分别使用沐浴湿巾、沐浴手套、洗发浴帽或失禁护理湿巾，更方便地完成日常身体和皮肤护理。
paragraphs.en: Caregivers can use bathing wipes, bathing gloves, shampoo caps, or continence care wipes as needed, making everyday body and skin care easier to complete.

heading.zh: 4. 婴幼儿与家庭日常清洁
heading.en: 4. Infant and Everyday Family Cleansing

body.zh: HOMEKEEP 纯水婴儿湿巾则覆盖另一类高频家庭护理需求。
body.en: HOMEKEEP Pure Water Wipes address another frequent home-care need.

paragraphs.zh: 从新生儿换尿布、手口及身体日常清洁，到敏感肌肤的温和擦拭，产品提供更简单的家庭日常清洁选择。
paragraphs.en: From diaper changes for newborns and everyday cleansing of hands, mouth, and body to gentle wiping of sensitive skin, the product offers a simpler option for everyday household cleansing.

heading.zh: 维尼健康——令每日护理更加简单
heading.en: VINNER Health — Making Everyday Care Simpler

body.zh: 如前文所说，维尼健康推出的是一整套清洁护理解决方案。医院病房关注床旁护理的效率、舒适与尊严；养老院关注长期照护的简化以及老年人的个人卫生和体面；家庭环境关注护理人员和家庭成员能否更容易完成日常清洁；婴幼儿护理则更加关注温和、简单和敏感肌适用性。
body.en: As noted above, VINNER Health offers a complete cleansing and care solution. In hospital wards, we focus on making bedside care more efficient, comfortable, and dignified; in nursing homes, we focus on making long-term care simpler while maintaining older adults’ personal hygiene and dignity; in the home, we focus on making everyday cleansing easier for caregivers and family members; and in infant care, we place greater emphasis on gentleness, simplicity, and suitability for sensitive skin.

paragraphs.zh: 因此，从 VINNERLOVE 的身体清洁、头发清洁和失禁皮肤护理，到 HOMEKEEP 的婴幼儿与敏感肌日常清洁，维尼健康正在逐步构建一套覆盖不同年龄、不同护理环境和不同清洁需求的个人护理产品组合。
paragraphs.en: From VINNERLOVE’s body cleansing, hair cleansing, and continence skin care to HOMEKEEP’s everyday cleansing for infants and sensitive skin, VINNER Health is gradually building a personal-care portfolio that serves different ages, care settings, and cleansing needs.

paragraphs.zh: 未来，我们也将继续围绕医院护理、老年护理、长期照护及家庭健康场景开发更多清洁与皮肤护理解决方案。
paragraphs.en: In the future, we will continue to develop more cleansing and skin-care solutions for hospitals, elder care, long-term care, and family health settings.

title.zh: VINNER 团队亮相 WHX Dubai 2026

body.zh: 2026年2月9日至12日，VINNER 团队在 WHX Dubai 2026 展会现场与来自全球医疗健康渠道的客户展开产品、项目和供应合作交流。
body.en: From February 9 to 12, 2026, the VINNER team met healthcare customers and channel partners at WHX Dubai 2026 to discuss products, projects, and supply collaboration.

news.alt: VINNER 团队参加 WHX Dubai 2026 的新闻主图

heading.zh: Day 0｜抵达 WHX Dubai 现场
heading.en: Day 0 | Arriving at WHX Dubai

body.zh: 展前一天，VINNER 团队抵达 WHX Dubai 2026 展会现场，完成展馆动线确认、展位搭建、主视觉检查、样品陈列和接待物料整理。对我们来说，展前准备不是单纯把产品摆出来，而是把清洁护理、感染控制、OEM/ODM 定制能力、SDS 与 Brochure 资料入口放进一条清晰的客户参观路径里，让不同市场的客户能够快速理解 VINNER 的产品线和项目响应方式。
body.en: Before the show opened, the VINNER team arrived at the WHX Dubai 2026 venue to confirm visitor flow, prepare the booth, check the key visual, arrange samples, and organize reception materials. For us, preparation was not just about displaying products; it was about turning Cleansing & Care, Infection Control, OEM/ODM capabilities, SDS files, and brochures into a clear visit path so customers from different markets could quickly understand VINNER product lines and project response.

heading.zh: Day 1-4｜接待客户与项目沟通

body.zh: 2月9日至12日展会期间，VINNER 团队持续接待来自中东、欧洲、非洲及其他市场的医疗健康渠道客户、品牌客户和项目合作伙伴。现场沟通从产品线介绍开始，逐步深入到基材选择、液体配方、装量规格、包装结构、标签语言、目标市场法规资料和交付周期。通过样品、包装和现场资料，客户可以直接比较产品手感、使用场景和定制边界，也能更快判断项目是否适合进入打样与报价阶段。

title.en: EU PPWR Requirements: Packaging Compliance Timeline and Importer Duties

body.zh: 《包装和包装废弃物法规》（Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation，PPWR）已经开始影响所有进入欧盟市场的包装产品。从 2026 年开始，欧盟对包装的监管将逐步覆盖受限物质、可回收设计、再生塑料比例、包装减量、统一标签及规模化回收等要求。部分关键要求将在2030、2035、2038 和 2040 年分阶段实施。
body.en: The Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) is beginning to affect every packaged product placed on the EU market. From 2026, EU packaging rules will progressively cover restricted substances, recyclable design, recycled-plastic content, packaging reduction, harmonised labelling and recycling at scale. Key requirements will take effect in stages in 2030, 2035, 2038 and 2040.

title.zh: 欧盟 PPWR 包装法规要求与合规时间表 | VINNER
title.en: EU PPWR Packaging Requirements and Compliance Timeline | VINNER

description.zh: 汇总欧盟 PPWR 对包装材料、可回收设计、再生塑料、包装减量和标签的分阶段要求，并说明欧盟进口商需要准备的合规文件。
description.en: A practical overview of EU PPWR requirements for packaging materials, recyclable design, recycled plastic, packaging reduction and labelling, with importer documentation duties.

heading.zh: 一、PPWR 是什么？
heading.en: 1. What Is the PPWR?

paragraphs.zh: 定义：《包装和包装废弃物法规》（Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, PPWR），即 Regulation (EU) 2025/40。PPWR 覆盖包装的整个生命周期，包括包装材料中的受限物质、可回收设计、再生塑料含量、包装减量、标签、重复使用以及包装废弃物管理等。[1]
paragraphs.en: Definition: The Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), Regulation (EU) 2025/40, covers the full life cycle of packaging, including restricted substances in packaging materials, design for recycling, recycled-plastic content, packaging reduction, labelling, reuse and packaging-waste management.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 目标：Eurostat 最新统计显示，2023 年欧盟共产生约 7,970 万吨包装废弃物，相当于人均 177.8 kg。其中纸和纸板占 40.4%，塑料占 19.8%，玻璃占 18.8%，木材占 15.8%。[2]。PPWR的主要目标包括减少包装废弃物、降低原生材料消耗、提高再生材料使用比例，并推动欧盟包装体系向循环经济转型。[3]
paragraphs.en: Objective: The latest Eurostat statistics show that the EU generated about 79.7 million tonnes of packaging waste in 2023, equal to 177.8 kg per person. Paper and cardboard accounted for 40.4%, plastic 19.8%, glass 18.8% and wood 15.8%.[2] The PPWR aims to reduce packaging waste, lower virgin-material consumption, increase recycled-material use and move the EU packaging system towards a circular economy.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 时间：PPWR于2025 年 2 月 11 日生效，并自 2026 年 8 月 12 日起适用。该法规取代原有 Directive 94/62/EC，并以欧盟 Regulation 的形式直接适用于成员国。[1]
paragraphs.en: Timeline: The PPWR entered into force on February 11, 2025 and applies from August 12, 2026. It replaces Directive 94/62/EC and applies directly in Member States as an EU Regulation.[1]

heading.zh: 二、PPWR不同阶段的对包装合规的要求
heading.en: 2. Packaging Compliance Requirements by PPWR Phase

paragraphs.zh: PPWR 的要求分阶段实施，不同行业和包装类型适用的具体要求存在差异。根据时间顺序，我们整理了PPWR不同阶段以及对不同行业的法规监管要求的简短总结。
paragraphs.en: The PPWR is implemented in phases, and the detailed requirements vary by industry and packaging type. The timeline below summarises the main regulatory requirements by date and application.

caption.zh: 表1 PPWR不同阶段的主要要求
caption.en: Table 1. Main PPWR requirements by phase

rows.zh: PPWR 开始适用。包装及包装组件中的铅、镉、汞和六价铬浓度总和不得超过100 mg/kg。[1]
rows.en: The PPWR applies. The combined concentration of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium in packaging and packaging components must not exceed 100 mg/kg.[1]

rows.zh: PFAS（Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances，全氟和多氟烷基物质）开始受到 Article 5 规定的浓度限制。[1]
rows.en: PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) become subject to the concentration limits in Article 5.[1]

rows.zh: Article 6(1) 要求投放欧盟市场的包装具有可回收性；具体 Design for Recycling 评价标准按照后续授权法案逐步落实。[1][4]
rows.en: Article 6(1) requires packaging placed on the EU market to be recyclable; detailed Design for Recycling criteria will be implemented through later delegated acts.[1][4]

rows.zh: 包装内部空余空间应减少至保证包装功能所必需的最低程度。[1]
rows.en: Empty space inside packaging must be reduced to the minimum needed for the packaging to function.[1]

rows.zh: 包装逐步采用欧盟统一标签标明材料组成，以支持消费者正确分类投放。[1]
rows.en: Packaging will progressively use harmonised EU labels to identify material composition and support correct sorting by consumers.[1]

rows.zh: 包装应标明其可重复使用属性，并通过 QR Code 或其他数字载体提供重复使用体系等信息。[1]
rows.en: Packaging must indicate that it is reusable and provide information about the reuse system through a QR code or another digital carrier.[1]

rows.zh: 按 Design for Recycling 评价包装可回收性能：Grade A ≥95%，Grade B ≥80%，Grade C ≥70%；低于 70% 属于技术上不可回收。[1]
rows.en: Recyclability is assessed under Design for Recycling: Grade A ≥95%, Grade B ≥80% and Grade C ≥70%; below 70% is technically non-recyclable.[1]

rows.zh: 最低再生塑料含量开始实施：接触敏感型 PET 包装30%；其他接触敏感型塑料包装10%；一次性塑料饮料瓶 30%；其他塑料包装35%。[1]
rows.en: Minimum recycled-plastic content begins: 30% for contact-sensitive PET packaging; 10% for other contact-sensitive plastic packaging; 30% for single-use plastic beverage bottles; and 35% for other plastic packaging.[1]

rows.zh: 包装重量和体积应减少至实现包装功能所需的最低程度，并限制双层壁、假底和不必要包装层等仅用于增加视觉体积的设计。[1]
rows.en: Packaging weight and volume must be reduced to the minimum needed for its function, limiting double walls, false bottoms and unnecessary layers used only to increase perceived volume.[1]

rows.zh: 分组包装、运输包装、电商包装
最大空余空间比例原则上不得超过50%。[1]
rows.en: The maximum empty-space ratio should in principle not exceed 50%.[1]

rows.zh: Annex V 所列部分一次性塑料包装开始受到限制，包括部分酒店和 HORECA 场景的一次性包装。[1]
rows.en: Certain single-use plastic packaging listed in Annex V becomes restricted, including some single-use packaging in hotel and HORECA settings.[1]

rows.zh: 在 Design for Recycling 基础上进一步加入 Recycled at Scale（规模化回收）要求，需要考虑包装是否能够在实际回收体系中被收集、分选和规模化回收。[1][4]
rows.en: Recycled at Scale requirements are added to Design for Recycling, considering whether packaging can be collected, sorted and recycled at scale in real systems.[1][4]

rows.zh: Grade C 包装原则上不得继续投放欧盟市场，包装需达到 Grade A 或 Grade B。[1]
rows.en: Grade C packaging may in principle no longer be placed on the EU market; packaging must achieve Grade A or Grade B.[1]

rows.zh: 最低再生塑料比例进一步提高：接触敏感型 PET 50%；其他接触敏感型塑料25%；一次性塑料饮料瓶 65%；其他塑料包装65%。[1]
rows.en: Minimum recycled-plastic content increases further: 50% for contact-sensitive PET; 25% for other contact-sensitive plastic; 65% for single-use plastic beverage bottles; and 65% for other plastic packaging.[1]

paragraphsAfter.zh: 此外，PPWR部分要求采用“固定日期或相关授权法案、实施法案生效后一定期限，以较晚者为准”的机制，因此实际强制日期还需结合欧盟后续二级立法确认。[1][4]
paragraphsAfter.en: Some PPWR provisions use a later-of mechanism, applying on a fixed date or after a defined period following the entry into force of a relevant delegated or implementing act, whichever is later. The final mandatory dates therefore need to be checked against subsequent EU secondary legislation.[1][4]

paragraphsAfter.zh: 同时，PPWR对不同行业的适用性有所差异。《欧盟化妆品法规》Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 范围内产品使用的部分包装属于 PPWR 所定义的 contact-sensitive packaging（接触敏感型包装），因此其塑料包装适用相应的再生塑料比例要求。[1]对于 Regulation (EU) 2017/745 范围内的医疗器械，PPWR 对部分接触敏感型包装设置了特定豁免。例如，部分医疗器械包装可豁免 Article 6 的部分可回收性要求及 Article 7 的最低再生塑料含量要求。其他适用要求仍需逐项判断。[1]
paragraphsAfter.en: Application also differs by sector. Some packaging used with products within the scope of the EU Cosmetics Regulation, Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, is contact-sensitive packaging under the PPWR and is therefore subject to the relevant recycled-plastic requirements.[1] For medical devices within the scope of Regulation (EU) 2017/745, the PPWR provides specific exemptions for some contact-sensitive packaging. For example, some medical-device packaging may be exempt from parts of the Article 6 recyclability requirements and the Article 7 minimum recycled-plastic requirements. Other applicable requirements still need to be assessed case by case.[1]

heading.zh: 三、对欧盟进口商意味着什么？
heading.en: 3. What Does the PPWR Mean for EU Importers?

paragraphs.zh: 根据 Article 18，进口商只能将符合 PPWR 相关要求的包装投放欧盟市场。在产品上市前，进口商需要确认制造商已经完成适用的包装符合性评估并准备技术文件，同时检查相关标签及符合性文件。[1]
paragraphs.en: Under Article 18, importers may place on the EU market only packaging that meets the applicable PPWR requirements. Before a product is placed on the market, importers should confirm that the manufacturer has completed the applicable packaging conformity assessment and prepared the technical documentation, and should check the relevant labels and conformity documents.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 进口商还需要保存 EU Declaration of Conformity。一次性包装相关文件原则上保存 5 年，可重复使用包装保存 10 年。监管机构提出合理要求时，进口商还应提供相关技术资料。[1]
paragraphs.en: Importers must also retain the EU Declaration of Conformity. Documents for single-use packaging should in principle be retained for five years, while documents for reusable packaging should be retained for ten years. Importers must provide the relevant technical information when reasonably requested by a market-surveillance authority.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 对于进口化妆品、医疗器械、清洁护理产品及其他消费品的企业，产品合规和包装合规都将成为欧盟市场准入管理的重要组成部分。
paragraphs.en: For businesses importing cosmetics, medical devices, cleansing and care products, and other consumer goods, both product compliance and packaging compliance will become important parts of EU market-access management.

heading.zh: 四、VINNER的PPWR合规准备
heading.en: 4. VINNER's PPWR Compliance Preparation

paragraphs.zh: 截至 2026 年，VINNER旗下品牌产品已完成现阶段适用的 PPWR 包装合规评估和文件准备，并将 2030、2035、2038 及 2040 年逐步实施的要求纳入包装设计和供应链管理体系。同时，针对OEM/ODM与合同制造的产品与客户，我们也能够为其准备好对应的技术文件、DoC以及PPWR相关检测报告。
paragraphs.en: As of 2026, VINNER's branded products have completed the packaging-compliance assessment and documentation applicable at this stage. The requirements scheduled for 2030, 2035, 2038 and 2040 have also been incorporated into packaging design and supply-chain management. For OEM/ODM and contract-manufacturing projects, we can prepare the corresponding technical files, DoC and PPWR-related test reports.

paragraphs.zh: 由于 2030 年以后部分具体评价方法仍需欧盟委员会通过授权法案和实施法案进一步确定，VINNER 将根据后续欧盟二级法规持续更新包装合规要求。[1][4]
paragraphs.en: Because some detailed assessment methods after 2030 still need to be specified by the European Commission through delegated and implementing acts, VINNER will continue updating its packaging-compliance requirements as the EU secondary legislation develops.[1][4]

heading.zh: 一、欧盟FLR的主要内容
heading.en: 1. What the EU FLR Covers

body.zh: FLR正式名称为：Regulation (EU) 2024/3015 on prohibiting products made with forced labour on the Union market，即《禁止强迫劳动产品条例》，已于 2024 年通过并生效，核心市场禁令将自 2027 年 12 月 14 日起正式适用和执行。届时，使用强迫劳动制造的产品不得投放或提供于欧盟市场，也不得从欧盟出口。
body.en: The formal name of the FLR is Regulation (EU) 2024/3015 on prohibiting products made with forced labour on the Union market. The regulation was adopted and entered into force in 2024, while its core market ban will apply and be enforced from December 14, 2027. Products made with forced labour may then neither be placed or made available on the EU market nor exported from the EU.

rows.en: Forced labour at any relevant stage, including extraction, harvesting, production, manufacturing or processing, may bring the finished product within the FLR

rows.en: There is no general minimum-share exemption; a product may remain in scope even when the forced-labour component is a small part of the finished product

rows.en: Uses the core definition in ILO Convention No. 29, focusing on whether work is voluntary and whether a penalty or coercive threat exists

rows.en: When suspected forced labour occurs outside the EU, the European Commission is in principle the Lead Competent Authority

rows.en: During a preliminary investigation, authorities may request measures taken to identify, prevent, mitigate, end and remedy forced-labour risks; businesses generally respond within 30 working days

rows.en: Authorities may prohibit continued placing, making available or exporting, and require products already on the market to be withdrawn and disposed of; member-state penalties may apply for non-compliance

rows.en: Not automatically exempt; if products remain placed or made available on the EU market after December 14, 2027, they may still be in scope even if made or imported earlier

rows.en: The FLR does not establish a universal “FLR certification” or a general mandatory audit or periodic-reporting duty for all businesses

heading.zh: 二、FLR 如何判断“强迫劳动”？
heading.en: 2. How Does the FLR Identify Forced Labour?

paragraphs.zh: FLR 使用国际劳工组织 ILO Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No.29) 所建立的强迫劳动概念。
paragraphs.en: The FLR uses the concept of forced labour established by the International Labour Organization's Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No. 29).

paragraphs.zh: 其核心判断可概括为两个方面：
paragraphs.en: The core assessment can be summarized in two questions:

paragraphs.zh: 第一，劳动是否真正自愿（voluntary）：员工是否在获得充分信息的情况下自由进入劳动关系，并能够自由终止劳动关系。
paragraphs.en: First, is the work genuinely voluntary? Did the employee enter the employment relationship freely and with sufficient information, and can they end it freely?

paragraphs.zh: 第二，是否存在惩罚或强制威胁（menace of penalty / coercion）：例如暴力或威胁、限制人员行动、债务束缚、扣押工资或身份证件、威胁解雇或遣返、利用劳动者弱势地位等。欧委会 2026 年指南同时指出，滥用加班要求也可能构成劳动非自愿性的风险表现。
paragraphs.en: Second, is there a menace of penalty or coercion, such as violence or threats, restricted movement, debt bondage, withheld wages or identity documents, threats of dismissal or deportation, or abuse of a worker's vulnerability? The Commission's 2026 guidance also notes that abusive overtime demands may indicate involuntary work.

heading.zh: 加班是否等于强迫劳动？
heading.en: Does Overtime Equal Forced Labour?

paragraphs.zh: 不等于。ILO 对这一问题有较明确的解释：加班本身并不自动构成强迫劳动，首先应当判断该加班是否符合所在国家或地区法律以及适用集体协议（collective agreements）规定的工时和加班限制。在此基础上，还需要进一步判断劳动者是否能够真正自主选择，以及是否存在处罚威胁。
paragraphs.en: No. The ILO gives a clear explanation: overtime does not automatically constitute forced labour. The first question is whether it complies with working-time and overtime limits under the applicable local law and collective agreements. The next questions are whether workers can make a genuine choice and whether a threat of penalty exists.

heading.zh: 对于企业而言，妥善的劳动管理应满足什么？
heading.en: What Should Responsible Labour Management Include?

bullets.zh: 加班工时符合当地法律及适用集体协议要求；
bullets.en: Overtime hours comply with local law and applicable collective agreements;

bullets.zh: 员工能够在法律允许范围内作出真实选择；
bullets.en: Employees can make a genuine choice within the limits allowed by law;

bullets.zh: 加班工资和待遇依法支付；
bullets.en: Overtime pay and benefits are provided as required by law;

bullets.zh: 不得通过罚款、扣薪、解雇威胁或其他惩罚方式强迫员工从事超出合法限度的加班。
bullets.en: Employees are not forced into overtime beyond legal limits through fines, withheld pay, threats of dismissal or other penalties.

paragraphsAfter.zh: 此外，ILO 特别指出，如果加班超过法律允许的周/月工时限额，同时又通过处罚威胁强制劳动者工作，就可能构成强迫劳动；即使员工理论上可以拒绝，但如果因为害怕失去工作或无法获得最低工资而事实上没有选择，也可能产生强迫劳动问题。
paragraphsAfter.en: The ILO also emphasizes that overtime may constitute forced labour when it exceeds legal weekly or monthly limits and workers are compelled to continue through threats of penalty. Even when employees can theoretically refuse, forced-labour concerns may arise if fear of losing their jobs or minimum wages leaves them with no real choice.

heading.zh: 三、欧盟进口商应该如何提前准备？
heading.en: 3. How Should EU Importers Prepare Early?

paragraphs.zh: 欧盟委员会已经明确将 2026 年至 2027 年 12 月 14 日之间定义为 FLR 的实施准备阶段。
paragraphs.en: The European Commission has defined the period from 2026 through December 14, 2027 as the FLR implementation-preparation phase.

paragraphs.zh: 对进口商而言，重点在于逐步建立一套能够支持产品供应链调查的证据体系。
paragraphs.en: For importers, the priority is to build an evidence system that can support a product supply-chain investigation.

bullets.zh: 首先，应提高供应链透明度，追溯生产全链条FLR合规情况：Product → Manufacturer → Key Suppliers → Key Raw Materials → Upstream Origin
bullets.en: First, improve supply-chain transparency and trace FLR compliance across the full chain: Product → Manufacturer → Key Suppliers → Key Raw Materials → Upstream Origin.

bullets.zh: 其次，可以将强迫劳动要求纳入 Supplier Code of Conduct、采购协议或供应商准入体系，并针对产品、地区、行业和供应商本身的风险采取不同程度的尽职调查。
bullets.en: Second, incorporate forced-labour requirements into the Supplier Code of Conduct, purchasing agreements or supplier-qualification system, using a level of due diligence proportionate to the risks of the product, region, industry and supplier.

bullets.zh: 对于风险较低的供应商，可以采取文件审核、自我评估和供应商声明；对于较高风险的供应商，则可以进一步使用第三方社会责任审核、现场评估、员工访谈或更深入的原材料追溯。
bullets.en: For lower-risk suppliers, document reviews, self-assessments and supplier declarations may be appropriate. Higher-risk suppliers may require third-party social audits, on-site assessments, worker interviews or deeper raw-material tracing.

heading.zh: 四、维尼健康能为欧洲进口商提供哪些 FLR Supporting Evidence？
heading.en: 4. What FLR Supporting Evidence Can VINNER Health Provide to European Importers?

paragraphs.zh: 对于欧洲进口商而言，供应商价值正在从简单的代工生产商转向更合乎道德、人权与法规的负责任的供应商。
paragraphs.en: For European importers, supplier value is shifting from simple contract manufacturing toward responsible suppliers with stronger ethics, human-rights practices and regulatory readiness.

bullets.zh: 第三方审核层面：维尼健康已完成 SMETA 4-Pillar Audit（SMETA4柱审计）。该审核覆盖劳工权益、员工健康与安全、工作环境和商业道德，可作为进口商了解制造端劳动和社会责任管理情况的一项第三方审核依据。同时，维尼健康已建立 ISO 9001、ISO 13485、ISO 22716、ISO 14001、ISO 45001等质量、环境和职业健康安全管理体系。

VINNER Health also maintains ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 22716, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems covering quality, environment and occupational health and safety.

bullets.zh: 双方合作层面：围绕 FLR 尽职调查需求，维尼可配合欧洲进口商提供和建立我们自身以及供应链的各类型的保障劳工权益与非强迫劳动证明。
bullets.en: Cooperation: To support FLR due diligence, VINNER can work with European importers to provide and establish evidence of labour-rights protection and the absence of forced labour across our own operations and the supply chain.

paragraphsAfter.zh: FLR 本身并没有规定企业必须采用上述某一种固定文件组合。欧委会指南强调的是企业能否提供相关、真实且可验证的信息，并证明其针对实际供应链风险采取过合理措施。
paragraphsAfter.en: The FLR does not require businesses to use one fixed combination of documents. The Commission's guidance focuses on whether a business can provide relevant, genuine and verifiable information and show that it took reasonable measures against the actual risks in its supply chain.

title.zh: 破局美国护理蓝海——医疗与养老市场免冲洗沐浴产品潜力深度洞察与合规解析
title.en: Breaking into the U.S. Care Blue Ocean—An In-Depth Insight into the Potential and Compliance of Rinse-Free Bathing Products in Healthcare and Elderly Care

body.zh: 美国医疗与养老市场正在加速采用免冲洗沐浴产品。本文从院感防控、采购需求、合规要求与照护尊严四个角度，分析免冲洗清洁方案的市场潜力与应用价值。
body.en: The U.S. healthcare and elderly-care market is accelerating its adoption of rinse-free bathing products. This article examines the market potential and practical value of rinse-free care through four lenses: infection control, procurement demand, compliance, and human dignity.

alt.zh: 护理人员为老年人提供日常照护
alt.en: A caregiver providing everyday care for an older adult

heading.zh: 1. 医疗系统———刚需驱动下的院感防控利器
heading.en: 1. Healthcare Systems—A Critical Tool for Healthcare-Associated Infection Control Driven by Essential Demand

paragraphs.zh: 在人口老龄化加剧与院内感染控制(HAIs)标准日益严格的背景下，美国医疗与养老市场正经历一场基础护理模式的变革。传统的“水盆+毛巾”沐浴方式因其交叉感染风险高、护理耗时长、患者体验不佳，正快速被专业化、标准化的免冲洗沐浴产品(Rinse-Free Bathing Products)所替代。这不仅是一场护理效率的升级，更代表着一个百亿级蓝海市场的崛起。
paragraphs.en: Against the backdrop of accelerating population aging and increasingly stringent standards for healthcare-associated infection (HAI) control, the U.S. healthcare and elderly-care market is undergoing a transformation in basic-care practices. The traditional "basin + towel" bathing method, with its high risk of cross-contamination, lengthy care time, and poor patient experience, is rapidly being replaced by professional, standardized Rinse-Free Bathing Products. This is not merely an upgrade in care efficiency; it also represents the rise of a blue-ocean market worth tens of billions of dollars.

paragraphs.zh: 美国拥有庞大的医院网络和长期护理设施，医疗级湿巾是维持其卫生标准的核心消耗品。最新行业报告显示，全球医疗湿巾市场在2024年估值为180.5亿美元，预计到2030年将以7.7%的复合年增长率(CAGR)达到277亿美元。其中，北美市场占据35.5%的最大份额，美国凭借其成熟的医疗体系成为绝对主力。
paragraphs.en: The United States has an extensive network of hospitals and long-term care facilities, and medical-grade wipes are core consumables for maintaining its hygiene standards. The latest industry reports show that the global healthcare wipes market was valued at US$18.05 billion in 2024 and is expected to reach US$27.7 billion by 2030 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 7.7%. North America holds the largest share at 35.5%, with the United States serving as the clear market leader thanks to its mature healthcare system.

paragraphs.zh: 外科手术部位感染(SSI)和导尿管相关尿路感染(CAUTI)等问题促使美国医院大量采用标准化沐浴方案。此外，ICU护士在传统床旁沐浴上耗费大量时间。权威临床研究表明，使用预先润湿、可微波加热的“抛弃型免洗湿巾”方案，在缩短操作时间、降低护理工作量及成本效益方面显著优于传统方法。在这一需求背景下，VINNERLOVE 免洗沐浴湿巾 (VLBBW8)与免洗沐浴手套(VLBBG8)的“8片式全身沐浴护理方案”完美契合了美国医疗系统的操作规范。每包8片对应身体8个不同部位，配合100GSM超厚无纺布与可微波加热设计，不仅杜绝了交叉污染，还能为ICU、术后患者提供安全、温暖的标准化床旁清洁。
paragraphs.en: Issues such as surgical-site infections (SSI) and catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI) have prompted U.S. hospitals to adopt standardized bathing protocols on a large scale. In addition, ICU nurses spend considerable time on traditional bedside bathing. Authoritative clinical research shows that a pre-moistened, microwaveable disposable no-rinse wipe protocol is significantly better than traditional methods in shortening procedure time, reducing nursing workload, and improving cost-effectiveness. Against this backdrop, the "eight-piece full-body bathing care solution" consisting of VINNERLOVE Rinse-Free Bathing Wipes (VLBBW8) and Rinse-Free Bathing Gloves (VLBBG8) fits perfectly with the operating protocols of the U.S. healthcare system. The eight pieces in each pack correspond to eight different body areas. Combined with 100 GSM ultra-thick nonwoven fabric and a microwaveable design, the solution not only prevents cross-contamination but also provides safe, warm, standardized bedside cleansing for ICU and postoperative patients.

heading.zh: 2. 从全美院线招标数据看“免洗清洁”的真实爆发力
heading.en: 2. What Nationwide U.S. Hospital Tender Data Reveal About the True Explosive Power of "Rinse-Free Cleaning"

paragraphs.zh: 要真正理解这片蓝海的深度，我们必须将目光投向美国各州政府、退伍军人事务部(VA)以及各大公立医疗体系的实际招标(RFP/Bid)数据。真实的标书数字，最能直观反映出院线的常态化消耗量。
paragraphs.en: To truly understand the depth of this blue ocean, we must turn to actual solicitation (RFP/Bid) data from U.S. state governments, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and major public healthcare systems. The real numbers in tender documents most directly reflect the routine consumption of hospital systems.

heading.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州退伍军人护理中心 (WV VNF) 标书解析
heading.en: West Virginia Veterans Nursing Facility (WV VNF) Tender Analysis

paragraphs.zh: 根据2026年4月美国西弗吉尼亚州采购部发布的官方标书(编号:CRFQ 0613 VNF2600000006)，仅针对该州单一一家退伍军人护理机构的年度耗材招标中，明确列出了庞大的基础护理品采购需求：免洗洗发帽(Shampoo Caps)招标需求量达每年46,200盒。同时，大型失禁护理湿巾及周边耗材同期招标采购量达到数万箱级别。
paragraphs.en: According to the official solicitation issued by the West Virginia Purchasing Division in April 2026 (Solicitation Number: CRFQ 0613 VNF2600000006), the annual consumables tender for a single veterans nursing facility in the state alone explicitly lists substantial demand for basic-care supplies: the annual demand for Shampoo Caps reaches 46,200 boxes. At the same time, the procurement volume for large incontinence-care wipes and related consumables reached the level of tens of thousands of cases.

paragraphs.zh: 试想，仅一个州的单一机构，每年对免洗洗发帽的常态化需求就接近5万盒。如果将这一数据放大到全美150多家VA医疗中心以及超过15,000家注册养老院，整体体量令人咋舌。这完美契合了VINNERLOVE 免冲洗洗发浴帽(VLSHMC1)的产品定位，其85GSM超厚多层无纺布材质、可微波加热的设计，完全能够满足甚至超越此类高标准政府招标的规格要求。
paragraphs.en: Just imagine: a single facility in one state has a routine annual demand for nearly 50,000 boxes of shampoo caps. Scaled to more than 150 VA medical centers nationwide and over 15,000 registered nursing homes, the overall volume is staggering. This aligns perfectly with the product positioning of VINNERLOVE Rinse-Free Shampoo and Bath Caps (VLSHMC1). Its 85 GSM ultra-thick multilayer nonwoven material and microwaveable design can fully meet—and even exceed—the specifications of high-standard government tenders of this kind.

paragraphs.zh: 此外，在联邦政府公开采购系统(SAM.gov)中，医院在标书中普遍明确规定：必须为免冲洗配方，且含有护肤屏障成分以应对失禁相关性皮炎(MASD)。大型医疗集团采购组织(GPO)如Cardinal Health 和 Premier，更是要求免洗产品中需含有聚二甲基硅氧烷(Dimethicone)。VINNERLOVE 失禁护理乳霜湿巾 (VLCONCW25)配方中正是采用了4%二甲基硅油与6%液体石蜡的组合，一步完成清洁、保湿、舒缓与屏障防护，精准对标了北美顶级医院采购准入标准。
paragraphs.en: In addition, in the federal government's public procurement system (SAM.gov), hospital solicitations commonly state that products must use a no-rinse formula and contain skin-barrier ingredients to address moisture-associated skin damage (MASD) related to incontinence. Large healthcare group purchasing organizations (GPOs) such as Cardinal Health and Premier go further by requiring dimethicone in rinse-free products. VINNERLOVE Continence Care Wipes (VLCONCW25) use a formulation combining 4% dimethicone and 6% liquid paraffin, completing cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection in one step and precisely matching the procurement-access standards of top North American hospitals.

heading.zh: 3. FDA Cosmetic 级合规护城河与免洗护理的极致体验

paragraphs.zh: 免洗沐浴产品之所以能在美国院线和个人护理市场迅速替代传统水盆沐浴，其核心在于前所未有的“便利性”以及基于美国FDA严格监管体系下的“安全性”承诺。
paragraphs.en: The reason rinse-free bathing products can rapidly replace traditional basin bathing in U.S. hospital systems and personal-care markets lies in their unprecedented convenience and their promise of safety under the strict regulatory framework of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

paragraphs.zh: 在美国市场，合规是第一生产力。根据美国《联邦食品、药品和化妆品法案》(FD&C Act)第201(i)条的规定，旨在用于人体“清洁(cleansing)”的物品即属于化妆品(Cosmetic)范畴。因此，免冲洗沐浴湿巾在美国受 FDA Cosmetic 级别严格监管，2022年签署的《化妆品监管现代化法案》(MoCRA)进一步要求企业必须建立标准化的高质量生产规范(GMP)。
paragraphs.en: In the U.S. market, compliance is the foundation of productivity. Under Section 201(i) of the U.S. Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), an article intended for use in "cleansing" the human body falls within the category of cosmetics. Therefore, rinse-free bathing wipes are subject to strict FDA cosmetic-grade oversight in the United States. The Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 (MoCRA), signed in 2022, further requires companies to establish standardized Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

paragraphs.zh: 面对极高的市场准入门槛，维尼健康(VINNER)已经构筑了全方位的技术文件与认证护城河。工厂不仅拥有 FDA Cosmetic GMP认证和ISO 13485医疗器械质量管理体系认证，更具备完善的理化与微生物测试，确保产品无金黄色葡萄球菌、铜绿假单胞菌等致病菌风险。针对敏感肌安全，VINNERLOVE 产品严格遵循化妆品行业最高安全标准之一的“人体重复斑贴试验(HRIPT)”，让“经皮肤科医生测试”拥有实打实的临床数据支撑。
paragraphs.en: Facing extremely high market-entry barriers, Vinner Health (VINNER) has built a comprehensive moat of technical documentation and certifications. The factory not only holds FDA Cosmetic GMP and ISO 13485 medical-device quality management system certifications, but also has complete physicochemical and microbiological testing capabilities, ensuring no risk from pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. For sensitive-skin safety, VINNERLOVE products strictly follow one of the cosmetics industry's highest safety standards, the Human Repeat Insult Patch Test (HRIPT), giving the claim "dermatologist tested" solid clinical data support.

heading.zh: 4. 在资源紧缺时代，以“免洗”捍卫生命尊严

paragraphs.zh: 当我们跳出冰冷的商业数据、合规条款与产能报表，再去审视免洗护理系列在美国市场迎来爆发的底层逻辑时，会发现其背后蕴含着更为深刻的社会价值。美国正全面步入“银发海啸(Silver Tsunami)”时代，医疗系统面临着前所未有的护士短缺与照护压力。免冲洗沐浴产品的引入，能够将单次基础护理的时间缩减高达60%，这种极简、高效的流程，让医护人员得以从繁重的体力劳动中抽身，将宝贵的时间重新投入到核心的临床救治中去。
paragraphs.en: When we step beyond cold commercial data, compliance clauses, and production-capacity reports and re-examine the underlying logic behind the explosive growth of rinse-free care products in the U.S. market, we find a deeper social value. The United States is fully entering the "Silver Tsunami" era, and its healthcare system faces unprecedented nursing shortages and caregiving pressure. This minimalist, efficient process allows healthcare workers to step away from burdensome physical labor and reinvest their precious time in core clinical treatment.

paragraphs.en: The highest form of business is technology for good. title.zh: 近期细菌暴发调查再敲警钟：环境卫生仍是感染控制的关键防线
title.en: Recent Bacterial Outbreak Investigations Sound Another Alarm: Environmental Hygiene Remains a Critical Line of Defense in Infection Control

body.zh: 耐药菌正在持续给医疗机构和公共卫生系统带来挑战。近期发表的三项细菌暴发调查分别发生在医院 ICU、社区服务场所和大型综合医院，涉及多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌（MRAB）、耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）以及耐碳青霉烯肺炎克雷伯菌。更值得关注的是，这些调查一次又一次将感染传播与患者周边环境、医疗设备、高频接触表面以及感染控制措施联系在一起。
body.en: Drug-resistant organisms continue to challenge healthcare institutions and public health systems. Three recently published bacterial outbreak investigations took place in a hospital ICU, a community service setting, and a large general hospital, involving multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (MRAB), methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), and carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae. More importantly, these investigations repeatedly linked transmission to patients' surrounding environments, medical equipment, high-touch surfaces, and infection-control measures.

alt.zh: 医疗环境中的感染控制与环境清洁
alt.en: Infection control and environmental cleaning in a healthcare setting

heading.zh: 1. 韩国首尔：ICU 暴发多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌，医疗设备检出暴发菌株
heading.en: 1. Seoul, South Korea: ICU Outbreak of Multidrug-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii; Outbreak Strains Detected on Medical Equipment

paragraphs.zh: 时间： 暴发于2023年12月出现明显上升，相关调查结果于2026年8月22日发表。
paragraphs.en: Time: The outbreak rose sharply in December 2023, and the investigation was published on August 22, 2026.

paragraphs.zh: 地点： 韩国首尔特别市龙山区，顺天乡大学首尔医院（Soonchunhyang University Seoul Hospital）一间28床综合内外科 ICU。[1]
paragraphs.en: Location: A 28-bed combined medical-surgical ICU at Soonchunhyang University Seoul Hospital in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, South Korea.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 病原体： 多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌（MRAB, Multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii）。
paragraphs.en: Pathogen: Multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (MRAB).

paragraphs.zh: 2023年12月，该院 ICU 的多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌病例突然增加。研究人员随后对 MRAB 定植患者周围的27个高频接触表面进行环境采样，并结合全基因组测序追踪传播链。[1]
paragraphs.en: In December 2023, cases of multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (MRAB) at the hospital rose suddenly. Researchers then collected environmental samples from patients colonized with MRAB across 27 high-touch surfaces and used whole-genome sequencing to trace the transmission chain.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 结果在3个呼吸机管路和1个血压袖带上检出了 MRAB。其中，血压袖带上的环境分离株与之后一名患者的临床分离株之间没有检测到 SNP 差异，提示环境污染与患者传播之间存在直接的流行病学联系。[1]
paragraphs.en: MRAB was detected on three ventilator circuits and one blood-pressure cuff. Notably, no SNP differences were detected between the environmental isolate from the blood-pressure cuff and the clinical isolate from a subsequent patient, suggesting a direct epidemiological link between environmental contamination and patient transmission.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 医院随后实施入院筛查、每周监测、接触隔离、提高清洁频率以及终末消毒等综合措施。MRAB 获得率由2023年12月的 18.56/1,000患者日下降至2025年2月的0。[1]
paragraphs.en: The hospital subsequently implemented a comprehensive set of measures, including admission screening, weekly surveillance, contact precautions, more frequent cleaning, and terminal disinfection. The MRAB acquisition rate fell from 18.56 per 1,000 patient-days in December 2023 to 0 in February 2025.[1]

paragraphs.zh: 这项研究最值得感染控制行业关注的一点很直接：患者周围的医疗设备和高频接触表面可以成为耐药菌传播链的一部分。
paragraphs.en: The most direct lesson for infection-control professionals is this: medical equipment and high-touch surfaces around patients can form part of a drug-resistant organism's transmission chain.

heading.zh: 2. 荷兰乌得勒支地区：按摩中心发生 MRSA 社区暴发，31人受影响
heading.en: 2. Utrecht Region, the Netherlands: Community MRSA Outbreak at a Massage Center Affected 31 People

paragraphs.zh: 时间：暴发持续于2023年11月至2024年6月，调查结果于2026年4月发表在美国 CDC 的Emerging Infectious Diseases。
paragraphs.en: Time: The outbreak continued from November 2023 to June 2024; the findings were published in April 2026 in the U.S. CDC's Emerging Infectious Diseases.

paragraphs.zh: 地点：荷兰乌得勒支地区（Public Health Service Region Utrecht）一家按摩中心。出于隐私原因，论文没有公开该按摩中心名称及具体所在城市。[2]
paragraphs.en: Location: A massage center in the Utrecht region (Public Health Service Region Utrecht), the Netherlands. For privacy reasons, the paper did not disclose the massage center's name or the specific city where it was located.[2]

paragraphs.zh: 病原体：PVL阳性耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA, Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus）。
paragraphs.en: Pathogen: PVL-positive methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA, Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus).

paragraphs.zh: 2023年11月，当地医院微生物实验室首先发现异常：短短3周内，5名患者因 MRSA 阳性脓肿就医并需要手术引流。流行病学调查很快将病例指向同一家按摩中心。[2]
paragraphs.en: In November 2023, the local hospital microbiology laboratory first detected an anomaly: within just three weeks, five patients developed MRSA-positive abscesses requiring surgical drainage. Epidemiological investigation quickly linked the cases to the same massage center.[2]

paragraphs.zh: 最终，此次暴发共确认31例 MRSA 病例：
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, 31 MRSA cases were confirmed in the outbreak:

paragraphs.zh: 更关键的是，调查人员进行了三轮环境采样，多处环境样本检出 MRSA；研究最终确认在暴发源场所的物体表面检测到了具有活性的 MRSA。暴发期间，该场所接受了专业公司的全面消毒，无法充分消毒的织物覆盖物等物品则被移除。[2]
paragraphs.en: More importantly, investigators conducted three rounds of environmental sampling, and MRSA was detected in multiple environmental samples; the study ultimately confirmed viable MRSA on object surfaces at the outbreak source. During the outbreak, the site received comprehensive disinfection by a professional company, while items such as fabric coverings that could not be adequately disinfected were removed.[2]

paragraphs.zh: 这起事件说明，MRSA 并不局限于医院。按摩中心、美容护理机构、康复机构等存在密切人体接触和共用设备的场所，同样可能面临交叉污染和传播风险。
paragraphs.en: This incident shows that MRSA is not confined to hospitals. Settings such as massage centers, beauty and personal-care facilities, and rehabilitation centers - where people have close physical contact and share equipment - may also face risks of cross-contamination and transmission.

heading.zh: 3. 韩国首尔：耐药肺炎克雷伯菌扩散至12个病区，38例医院相关病例
heading.en: 3. Seoul, South Korea: Drug-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae Spread to 12 Wards, Causing 38 Hospital-Associated Cases

paragraphs.zh: 时间：暴发发生于2025年1月至5月；研究于2026年6月5日在线发表，并刊载于 Journal of Hospital Infection 2026年8月刊。[3]
paragraphs.en: Time: The outbreak occurred from January to May 2025; the study was published online on June 5, 2026, and appeared in the Journal of Hospital Infection August 2026 issue.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 地点：韩国首尔特别市恩平区，韩国天主教大学恩平圣母医院（Eunpyeong St. Mary’s Hospital）。该院是一所拥有808张床位的大学附属医院。[3]
paragraphs.en: Location: Eunpyeong St. Mary's Hospital in Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul, South Korea. The university-affiliated hospital has 808 beds.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 病原体：以 OXA-181 产酶肺炎克雷伯菌 ST16（OXA-181-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae ST16）为主。
paragraphs.en: Pathogen: Predominantly OXA-181-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae ST16 (OXA-181-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae ST16).

paragraphs.zh: 2025年2月，该院血液科连续发现两例 OXA-48-like 碳青霉烯酶产生肠杆菌目细菌病例，随后病例迅速扩散至多个病区。[3]
paragraphs.en: In February 2025, the hospital's hematology department identified two consecutive cases of OXA-48-like carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales, after which cases rapidly spread to multiple wards.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 整个调查期间共发现 38例医院相关病例，涉及12个病区。其中：
paragraphs.en: During the investigation, 38 hospital-associated cases were identified across 12 wards. Of these:

paragraphs.zh: 全基因组测序进一步证实了 OXA-181-producing K. pneumoniae ST16 的克隆传播。研究发现，患者在不同病区之间转移进一步放大了传播范围。加强高风险患者监测及其他感染预防与控制措施后，此次暴发在约4个月内得到控制。[3]
paragraphs.en: Whole-genome sequencing further confirmed clonal transmission of OXA-181-producing K. pneumoniae ST16. The study found that transfers of patients between wards further amplified the spread. After intensified surveillance of high-risk patients and other infection-prevention and control measures, the outbreak was brought under control in approximately four months.[3]

paragraphs.zh: 这起事件再次展示了耐药菌在大型医院内的传播能力：当高风险病原体进入医疗机构后，患者、医护人员、设备和环境共同构成的复杂接触网络，都需要纳入感染控制体系。
paragraphs.en: This incident once again demonstrates the ability of drug-resistant organisms to spread through large hospitals: once a high-risk pathogen enters a healthcare facility, the complex contact network formed by patients, healthcare workers, equipment, and the environment must all be incorporated into the infection-control system.

heading.zh: 4. VINNER 的观察：感染控制必须关注“环境”
heading.en: 4. VINNER's Perspective: Infection Control Must Address the "Environment"

paragraphs.zh: 三起暴发发生在不同时间、不同国家和不同场所，其传播机制也并不完全相同。但它们共同说明了一件事：
paragraphs.en: The three outbreaks occurred at different times, in different countries and settings, and their transmission mechanisms were not identical. Yet together they make one point clear:

paragraphs.zh: 感染控制从来不是单一措施能够完成的。
paragraphs.en: Infection control can never be achieved by a single measure alone.

paragraphs.zh: 患者筛查、隔离、手卫生、个人防护、医疗设备管理、环境清洁和表面消毒需要共同组成完整的 Infection Prevention and Control（IPC）体系。特别是在 ICU、病房、门诊以及其他人员频繁接触的场所，床栏、血压袖带、医疗设备外表面、操作台、门把手等高频接触表面会不断经历“手—表面—设备—患者”的接触过程。
paragraphs.en: Patient screening, isolation, hand hygiene, personal protective equipment, medical-equipment management, environmental cleaning, and surface disinfection must together form a complete Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) system. Especially in ICUs, wards, outpatient clinics, and other settings with frequent human contact, high-touch surfaces such as bed rails, blood-pressure cuffs, the exterior surfaces of medical equipment, worktops, and door handles repeatedly experience a "hand-surface-equipment-patient" chain of contact.

paragraphs.zh: 韩国 MRAB 暴发中从血压袖带检出的环境菌株与患者临床菌株高度一致；荷兰 MRSA 暴发中则直接从暴发源场所的环境表面检出了具有活性的 MRSA。[1][2]这些证据提醒我们：环境表面消毒不是感染控制的全部，但它是其中不可缺失的一环。
paragraphs.en: In the Korean MRAB outbreak, the environmental isolate from a blood-pressure cuff was highly consistent with the patient's clinical isolate; in the Dutch MRSA outbreak, viable MRSA was directly detected on environmental surfaces at the outbreak source.[1][2] This evidence reminds us: environmental surface disinfection is not all of infection control, but it is an indispensable part of it.

paragraphs.zh: 而对于专业消毒产品而言，最重要的是：产品是否经过标准化测试、能够覆盖哪些微生物，以及其接触时间和实际擦拭条件下的性能是否得到验证。
paragraphs.en: For professional disinfectant products, the most important point is: whether the product has undergone standardized testing, which microorganisms it covers, and whether its performance under its stated contact time and actual wiping conditions has been validated.

paragraphs.en: VINNERLOVE Surface Disinfectant Wipes is an alcohol-free surface disinfectant wipe currently under development, designed for healthcare facilities and other professional infection-control settings.

paragraphs.zh: 产品已由第三方实验室按照BS EN 13727:2012+A2:2015开展杀菌活性测试。EN 13727是用于评价医疗领域化学消毒剂和防腐剂杀菌活性的定量悬液试验（Phase 2, Step 1）的欧盟标准。测试采用产品湿巾挤出液原液，在 20°C 条件下进行，判定要求为细菌数量降低 ≥5 log（99.999%）。[4]本次报告共涉及 12个测试菌株/耐药株项目，包括鲍曼不动杆菌、大肠杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、铜绿假单胞菌、海氏肠球菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、屎肠球菌，以及 MRSA、VRE 等耐药菌株。[4]
paragraphs.en: The product has been tested for bactericidal activity by a third-party laboratory in accordance with BS EN 13727:2012+A2:2015. EN 13727 is the European standard for the quantitative suspension test (Phase 2, Step 1) used to evaluate the bactericidal activity of chemical disinfectants and antiseptics in the medical field. title.zh: 面向美国市场的化妆品品牌代工厂合规检查清单
title.en: Checklist for Cosmetic OEM/ODM Manufacturers Serving the U.S. Market

body.zh: 对于计划进入美国市场的化妆品品牌而言，选择 OEM/ODM 制造商时，除了配方、价格和产能，更需要关注供应商是否具备满足美国法规要求的合规基础。随着美国《2022 年化妆品法规现代化法案》（MoCRA）实施，化妆品制造设施、加工设施以及责任人的法规责任已经更加明确。
body.en: For cosmetic brands planning to enter the U.S. market, selecting an OEM/ODM manufacturer involves much more than formulation, pricing, and production capacity. Brands should also evaluate whether the supplier has the regulatory and compliance foundation required for the U.S. market. Following the implementation of the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 (MoCRA), the responsibilities of cosmetic manufacturing facilities, processing facilities, and Responsible Persons have become much clearer.

blogs.alt: VINNER 化妆品与湿巾生产车间

heading.zh: 前言
heading.en: Introduction

body.zh: 对于寻找化妆湿巾、清洁湿巾、卸妆湿巾、身体护理产品及其他化妆品 OEM/ODM 制造商的品牌方而言，供应商评估建议同时关注两方面：第一是美国法规规定的基础合规要求，第二是供应商额外具备的质量管理和供应链管理能力。
body.en: For brands sourcing cosmetic wipes, cleansing wipes, makeup remover wipes, body care products, and other cosmetic OEM/ODM products, supplier qualification should focus on two areas: the basic compliance requirements established by U.S. regulations, and the supplier's additional capabilities in quality management and supply chain management.

heading.zh: 1. 美国法规要求的基础合规条件
heading.en: 1. Basic Compliance Requirements Under U.S. Regulations

body.zh: 达到法规规定的基础要求，是品牌筛选海外化妆品 OEM/ODM 供应商的起点。
body.en: Meeting the basic regulatory requirements is the starting point for qualifying an overseas cosmetic OEM/ODM supplier.

heading.zh: 1.1 FDA 设施注册与 FEI
heading.en: 1.1 FDA Facility Registration and FEI

body.zh: 根据 21 U.S.C. § 364c，在美国销售化妆品的制造或加工设施，原则上需要向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）完成设施注册，并按规定更新注册信息。FDA 使用 FDA Establishment Identifier（FEI，FDA 机构识别码）作为化妆品设施注册中的设施识别号码。
body.en: Under 21 U.S.C. § 364c, facilities that manufacture or process cosmetic products for distribution in the United States are generally required to register with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and renew their registration as required. FDA uses the FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI) as the facility identifier for cosmetic facility registration.

paragraphs.zh: 因此，在选择海外化妆品制造商时，品牌方应确认：
paragraphs.en: When selecting an overseas cosmetic manufacturer, brands should confirm whether:

bullets.zh: 制造工厂是否拥有有效的 FEI；
bullets.en: The manufacturing facility has a valid FEI;

bullets.zh: 制造工厂是否有指定的美国代理（U.S. Agent）；
bullets.en: The manufacturing facility has designated a U.S. Agent;

bullets.zh: 相关生产设施是否已经完成 FDA Cosmetic Facility Registration。
bullets.en: The relevant manufacturing facility has completed FDA Cosmetic Facility Registration.

paragraphsAfter.zh: 需要特别注意：FDA 化妆品设施注册并不等同于 FDA 对工厂或产品的批准或认证。FDA 已明确说明，Facility Registration 和 Product Listing 并不是 FDA 的产品批准程序。因此，在供应商审核过程中，对于所谓“FDA Approved Factory”等表述，应保持谨慎。
paragraphsAfter.en: It is important to note that FDA cosmetic facility registration does not mean FDA has approved or certified the facility or its products. FDA has stated that facility registration and product listing are not product approval programs. Brands should therefore be cautious of descriptions such as “FDA Approved Factory.”

heading.zh: 1.2 产品列名：通常由品牌方负责
heading.en: 1.2 Cosmetic Product Listing: Usually the Brand's Responsibility

body.zh: MoCRA 同时要求在美国市场销售的化妆品完成 Cosmetic Product Listing（化妆品产品列名）。这一责任通常由产品的 Responsible Person（责任人）承担。根据美国法规，Responsible Person 指产品标签上所列明的制造商、包装商或经销商。
body.en: MoCRA also requires cosmetic products marketed in the United States to complete Cosmetic Product Listing. This responsibility generally belongs to the Responsible Person, meaning the manufacturer, packer, or distributor whose name appears on the product label.

paragraphs.zh: 对于 OEM 或 Private Label 项目，Responsible Person 通常是美国品牌方或经销商。不过，在进行 Product Listing 时，需要申报该产品实际生产设施的相关信息，因此制造商的 FDA 境外设施注册和 FEI 码会直接关系到客户后续的产品列名工作。
paragraphs.en: For OEM or Private Label projects, the Responsible Person is commonly the U.S. brand owner or distributor. However, Product Listing must include information about the facility where the product is manufactured, so the manufacturer's FDA facility registration and FEI are directly relevant to the customer's later product-listing work.

heading.zh: 1.3 注册并不等于产品已经合规
heading.en: 1.3 Registration Does Not Mean the Product Is Automatically Compliant

body.zh: 完成设施注册只是进入美国市场的基础条件之一，并不意味着具体产品已经自动符合美国法规。根据 MoCRA，Responsible Person 必须确保产品具备充分的 Safety Substantiation（安全性证明），并通过科学合理的测试、研究、分析或其他证据支持产品的安全性。
body.en: Completing facility registration is only one of the basic requirements for entering the U.S. market. It does not mean that a specific cosmetic product automatically complies with all applicable U.S. regulations. Under MoCRA, the Responsible Person must ensure that the product has adequate Safety Substantiation supported by scientifically appropriate tests, studies, analyses, or other evidence.

paragraphs.zh: 同时，还需要正确判断产品在美国的法规分类属性。以清洁、美化或保持皮肤良好状态为主要用途的湿巾，可能属于 Cosmetic（化妆品）。但如果产品涉及抗菌、消毒、治疗、预防疾病、改变人体结构或功能等宣称，则可能进入不同的 FDA 法规路径，不能简单按照普通化妆品管理。
paragraphs.en: The product's regulatory classification must also be evaluated carefully. Wipes intended primarily for cleansing, beautifying, or maintaining the skin in good condition may qualify as cosmetics. However, claims relating to antimicrobial activity, disinfection, treatment, disease prevention, or affecting the structure or function of the body may place a product on a different FDA regulatory pathway.

heading.zh: 2. 除上述基础条件外，还应该看制造商哪些能力？
heading.en: 2. Beyond the Basic Requirements, What Else Should You Evaluate in a Manufacturer?

body.zh: 达到法规最低要求，只是筛选供应商的第一步。对于国际品牌，特别是拥有多个 SKU、长期 OEM/ODM 项目或需要进行供应商审核的企业而言，一个成熟制造商还应具备系统化的质量管理、化妆品 GMP、环境管理、职业健康安全、劳工权益、商业道德以及供应链安全管理能力。
body.en: Meeting the minimum regulatory requirements is only the first step in supplier qualification. For international brands, particularly those managing multiple SKUs, long-term OEM/ODM programs, or formal supplier audits, a mature manufacturer should also demonstrate systematic capabilities in quality management, cosmetic GMP, environmental management, occupational health and safety, labor rights, responsible business practices, business ethics, and supply chain security.

paragraphs.zh: 这也是 ISO 管理体系以及第三方供应链安全审核的重要价值所在：它们帮助品牌在产品质量和法规准备之外，进一步了解供应商的过程管理、现场控制和长期交付能力。
paragraphs.en: This is where ISO management systems and independent third-party supply chain security audits provide additional value: they give brands visibility into process management, site controls, and long-term delivery capability beyond product quality and regulatory preparation.

heading.zh: 3. 维尼健康：为美国市场 OEM/ODM 项目建立完善的合规基础
heading.en: 3. VINNER: A Comprehensive Compliance Foundation for U.S.-Market OEM/ODM Projects

body.zh: 维尼健康长期为国际化妆品及湿巾品牌提供 OEM/ODM 制造服务，并建立了覆盖 FDA 注册、质量管理、化妆品 GMP、环境管理、职业健康安全、劳工权益、商业道德以及供应链安全管理的综合能力框架。
body.en: VINNER has long provided OEM/ODM manufacturing services for international cosmetic and wet wipe brands and has established a comprehensive framework covering FDA registration, quality management, cosmetic GMP, environmental management, occupational health and safety, labor rights, responsible business practices, business ethics, and supply chain security.

heading.zh: 3.1 FDA 注册制造设施
heading.en: 3.1 FDA-Registered Manufacturing Facility

body.zh: VINNER 已建立包括以下内容在内的美国化妆品制造设施合规基础：
body.en: VINNER has established the following compliance foundation for cosmetic manufacturing facilities serving the U.S. market:

bullets.zh: FDA Establishment Identifier（FEI）；
bullets.en: FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI);

bullets.zh: FDA Cosmetic Facility Registration；
bullets.en: FDA Cosmetic Facility Registration;

bullets.zh: Designated U.S. Agent（指定美国代理）。
bullets.en: Designated U.S. Agent.

paragraphs.zh: 这意味着，在客户进行 MoCRA Product Listing 时，可以使用已经完成 FDA 注册的制造设施及其 FEI 信息，从而减少供应商准入及法规准备过程中的不确定性。
paragraphs.en: When customers complete their MoCRA Product Listing, they can reference a manufacturing facility that has already completed FDA registration and has an established FEI, reducing uncertainty during supplier qualification and regulatory preparation.

heading.zh: 3.2 完善的质量管理与化妆品 GMP 体系
heading.en: 3.2 Comprehensive Quality Management and Cosmetic GMP Systems

body.zh: 维尼健康的管理体系与 GMP 体系包括：
body.en: VINNER's quality management and GMP systems include:

bullets.zh: ISO 9001 —— 质量管理体系：为过程控制、客户要求管理、纠正措施、风险管理以及持续改进提供系统化框架。
bullets.en: ISO 9001 — Quality Management System: a framework for process control, customer requirement management, corrective actions, risk management, and continual improvement.

bullets.zh: ISO 22716 —— 化妆品良好生产规范：针对化妆品生产、控制、储存和运输环节提出 GMP 管理要求，是国际市场广泛认可的化妆品 GMP 体系之一。
bullets.en: ISO 22716 — Cosmetics Good Manufacturing Practices: guidance covering the production, control, storage, and shipment of cosmetic products, and one of the widely recognized cosmetic GMP frameworks in international markets.

bullets.zh: FDA Cosmetic GMP Guidelines：VINNER 的化妆品生产管理参考 FDA 化妆品 GMP 指南及相关检查要求建立控制体系，并取得由 Intertek 认证的 GMP 证书。
bullets.en: FDA Cosmetic GMP Guidelines: VINNER's cosmetic manufacturing controls reference FDA cosmetic GMP guidance and relevant inspection expectations, supported by a GMP certificate issued by Intertek.

bullets.zh: ISO 14001 & ISO 45001 —— 环境管理体系与职业健康安全管理体系：补充环境管理、工作场所安全、风险控制以及持续改进机制。
bullets.en: ISO 14001 & ISO 45001 — Environmental Management and Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems: additional evidence of environmental management, workplace safety, risk control, and continual improvement.

bullets.zh: SMETA —— 社会责任与道德贸易审核：通过独立第三方审核机构评估劳动标准、职业健康与安全，并根据审核范围覆盖环境管理和商业道德。
bullets.en: SMETA — Social Responsibility and Ethical Trade Audit: an independent third-party assessment of labor standards and occupational health and safety, with environmental management and business ethics covered depending on scope.

bullets.zh: Intertek Global Security Verification（GSV）—— 全球供应链安全验证：覆盖工厂物理安全、人员安全、集装箱安全、封条管理、业务合作伙伴安全、网络安全、国际货运及供应链安全。
bullets.en: Intertek Global Security Verification (GSV): a supply chain security assessment covering physical facility security, personnel security, container security, seal management, business partner security, cybersecurity, international transportation, and supply chain security.

paragraphs.zh: 对于国际品牌而言，SMETA 审核可以在传统的产品质量和法规审核之外，进一步提供供应商在负责任生产、劳工管理及可持续供应链管理方面的信息，从而支持品牌开展供应商尽职调查和长期合作伙伴评估。
paragraphs.en: For international brands, a SMETA audit provides visibility beyond traditional product quality and regulatory audits by assessing responsible manufacturing, labor management, and sustainable supply chain capabilities, supporting supplier due diligence and long-term partner evaluation.

paragraphs.zh: 对于美国品牌及进口商而言，GSV 则为海外制造及国际物流环节提供额外的供应链安全视角。合规应该帮助客户降低风险，而不是增加工作量。
paragraphs.en: For U.S. brands and importers, GSV adds visibility into overseas manufacturing and international logistics. Compliance should help customers reduce risk—not create more work.

heading.zh: 结语
heading.en: Conclusion

body.zh: 通过以上体系，VINNER 可以为计划进入美国市场的化妆品及湿巾品牌提供更加成熟的制造和合规基础，帮助客户降低供应商审核、法规准备和供应链管理过程中的风险。对于正在开发化妆湿巾、个人护理湿巾以及 Private Label 化妆品的美国品牌而言，合规不应该等产品生产完成后才开始，而应该从选择制造商的第一步开始。
body.en: Through these systems and compliance capabilities, VINNER provides brands planning to enter the U.S. cosmetics and wet wipes market with a more mature manufacturing and compliance foundation. For U.S. brands developing cosmetic wipes, personal care wipes, and Private Label cosmetic products, compliance should not begin after the product has been manufactured. It should begin with the very first step: choosing the right manufacturer.
